notes.title: Update #5 - Some fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After some precious feedback, we decided to implement a few small modifications to the game:

[list]
[*] Level number and name is now visible in the mural
[*] Possibility of reactivate the tutorial dialog after it has been dismissed
[*] Volume of music and fx was increased. It was too low.
[*] Arrow keys are now usable the same way as WASD keys
[*] Added new option in the control scheme to have fixed control movement. In this scheme, the camera does not dictate the movement orientation
[*] Some other small fixes.
[/list]

Hope you like this new small changes.

Thank you very much for playing Sunset Shapes !!!

notes.title: Update #3 - Final chapter
notes.content:
Hi again everyone!

We've just released the final chapter of Sunset Shapes.
Maggot and Daisy have arrived to their destination :)

This chapter introduces:

[list]
[*] 12 new levels to play.
[*] New game mechanic. Some pieces in the level will rotate continuously in different intervals.
[*] Several bug fixes.
[*] Several performance improvements.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update.
Thank you very much for playing Sunset Shapes !!!

notes.title: Update #2 - 3rd chapter
notes.content:
Hi again everyone!

We've just released the 3rd chapter of Sunset Shapes.
Maggot and Daisy are now traveling through the countryside.

This chapter introduces:

[list]
[*] 11 new levels to play.
[*] New game mechanic. Some pieces in the level will move between two positions in different intervals.
[*] 6 new achievements (one for each chapter).
[*] Game save files are now stored in Steam Cloud.
[*] Several bug fixes.
[*] Several performance improvements.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update.
Thank you very much for playing Sunset Shapes !!!

notes.title: Update #1 - 2nd chapter
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've just released the 2nd chapter of Sunset Shapes.
Maggot and Daisy are now traveling around the city block and surroundings.

This chapter introduces:

[list]
[*] 13 new levels to play.
[*] New game mechanic. Some pieces in the level have gravity and fall if not selected. This means that to be put in place, the must be supported by other pieces.
[*] New shadows design. Now, if the shadow is inside the delimited zone, it will appear green and otherwise red. This makes it easier to see if the piece is in the right place or not.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update.
Thank you very much for playing Sunset Shapes !!!
